scope.summary: Implement internal-line authoring on Panel geometry: add named internal edge records (InternalLine type with role: FoldLine | PleatLine | DartLine | StressSeam | Baseline) to GarmentSpec panels, distinct from the outer outline and seam edges, carried into UV/texture and solver constraint generation
acceptance_criteria: InternalLine type carries: id, panel_id, role (FoldLine | PleatLine | DartLine | StressSeam | Baseline | TopstichLine), start_cm: [f32;2], end_cm: [f32;2] or Bezier shape
add_internal_line(panel_id, role, geometry) stores the line in tailor_panels spec_json and emits TailorPanelCrdtUpdateRecorded
Internal lines with role=FoldLine generate a fold seam constraint in the solver (distinct from seam join constraints), controlling fold angle
Internal lines with role=TopstitchLine are carried into the UV/texture renderer (MT-226 topstitch rendering feeds from these)
Internal lines do not affect PANEL_CLOSED (they are interior, not outline edges)
Model-accessible via edit_panel MCP tool with operation=add_internal_line

All operator-facing scope is implemented in src/frontend/handshake_native with native wgpu/egui, AccessKit author_id, Argus inspection/steering/capture, and no Tailor React, Tauri-command, WebView, data-testid-only, or rendered-PNG frontend path.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-345 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.
scope.risk_if_missed: MT-132 covers guide lines for topstitch/texture rendering only. Without a general InternalLine authoring API, fold lines (MD Fold Seam Line), dart lines with tip convergence, pleat fold indicators, and stress-seam lines cannot be authored as named, typed geometry. Dart handling (MT-122) and pleat handling (MT-123) depend on this substrate — without it they operate on implicit coordinates rather than authorable line records, making model-driven editing of darts and pleats fragile.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

Bind this scope to the native 2D Pattern pane, shared selection/property/history, and queued topology transaction contracts.
